full_matrix_cost_gate.denominator: complete consumed observations; each group uses the largest of its three repeat means
full_matrix_cost_gate.numerator: all owner observation/envelope attempts plus all main response attempts
full_matrix_cost_gate.timing: elapsed monotonic work intervals; not operating-system thread CPU time

interpretation: Descriptive ranges/medians over independent asynchronous runs, not causal paired comparisons. Exact geometry is at copied native publication poses. Counts are observation samples, not cell-ticks. Positive-overlap span is the time between consecutive positive sampled publications, not proof of unobserved continuity. Response energy excludes separate gravity, ordinary coupling, damping and hard contacts. Cost gate includes all worker attempts (including overwritten publications and refusals) and every main response attempt, divided conservatively by complete consumed observations. CPU cost is provisional; no GPU or human gameplay acceptance.
